data.title: bn-3qb8: Expose F-37 after-owner-read caveat in finding projections
data.description: Review exact commit 911beef. Check coherent current-record projection, F-37 true versus ordinary positive false, withholding for non-applicable states, stable wire compatibility, and safe human rendering.

data.reason: BLOCK: docs/contracts/scourge-v1.json adds after_owner_read as boolean? to the existing closed finding shape, but this generator interprets ? as required-nullable and emits FindingSummary with #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]. Therefore current ResponseV1 rejects prior v1 findings that omit after_owner_read, and prior v1 readers reject new findings that contain it. This violates bn-3qb8 backward-compatible projection acceptance. Preserve compatibility explicitly (for example through an actually versioned/compatible wire evolution or another design that both old and new readers can consume) and add two regression witnesses: current reader accepts the prior frozen response, and prior-contract reader accepts the new response. The coherent projection, true/false/null semantics, custody fields, and human rendering otherwise look sound; focused coherent/read/contract tests passed.

LGTM: reviewed the full 4159b19..2a72e8c range. finding_caveats is an omissible typed member on the extensible response envelope; the closed nested finding shape is unchanged. Current readers accept the exact pre-caveat response, the frozen pre-caveat reader retains the new member through extensions, and the caveat is projected only from the coherent current exact qualified-positive status record. False, invalid/non-positive, historical, objected, unqualified, and withheld paths emit no caveat; human rendering emits only fixed true/false text.
